money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The currency of Paraguay is the Guarani (PYG). Declare all amounts over USD10,000 (or its foreign equivalent) on arrival and departure. Failing to do so is a violation and can result in the seizure and forfeiture of your money. Use registered banks or an exchange bureau to change money. Avoid changing money with people on the streets. Counterfeit notes are common. You may need to show ID when paying with a credit or debit card.

laws.rule: There are strict rules about goods you can take into and out of the country. In Paraguay it's illegal to: import or export firearms, medications, toys that look like weapons, and protected species hunt animals remove certain plant species from nature reserves
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: Driving with 0.200 to 0.250 mg per litre of breath, or 0.400 to 0.500 g per litre of blood, is a serious traffic fault (Ley 5016 de 2014, art. 112 x). From 0.251 to 0.399 mg/L of breath or 0.501 to 0.799 g/L of blood it is a very serious fault (art. 113 g), and above that the file goes to the public prosecutor. Refusing the alcohol or drug test is also a very serious fault (art. 113 h). Limits as rewritten by Ley 6842.
laws.penalty_signal: Traffic fault; referral to the prosecutor above the upper band

laws.rule: Holding a prescribed substance, or one for exclusive personal use, is exempt from penalty; more than the prescribed or personal-use amount carries two to four years in prison and forfeiture (Ley 1340 de 1988, art. 30). For a person dependent on a drug, the daily-use amount is set case by case by a forensic doctor and a Health Ministry doctor, and for marijuana it does not exceed 10 g, and for cocaine, heroin and other opiates 2 g. Text as published on the BACN page; later amending laws (for example Ley 6902) did not show a change to art. 30 in what was read.
laws.penalty_signal: Above personal use: 2 to 4 years in prison

laws.rule: Smoking, vaping and keeping tobacco products lit are banned in schools, public transport and terminals, cinemas, theatres, libraries, museums, health centres, shops and supermarkets, enclosed workplaces, petrol stations, pubs, restaurants, discos, bars and casinos, lifts and children's play areas, except in specially permitted spots (Ley 5538 de 2015, art. 9). Ley 7508 de 2025, art. 11 allows smoking or vaping only outdoors where no people are present and no non-smokers pass through, with the Health Ministry defining smoke-free spaces.

Only temporary exit of national cultural heritage goods is allowed, with the Secretaria Nacional de Cultura's authorisation and a guarantee they return (Ley 5621 de 2016, art. 25). Trafficking cultural goods out of the country is punished with 2 to 10 years in prison (art. 41 d).
laws.penalty_signal: 2 to 10 years in prison for trafficking abroad

laws.rule: In protected areas covered by MADES public-use rules, register at the control post. Groups larger than 15 need a visit notification issued by the protected-areas directorate before travel. Camp, light fires or swim only in designated places, obey ranger restrictions, and take a ranger on remote or difficult trails where signs require one. Do not disturb wildlife or collect plants or material without permission. Domestic animals require administration authorisation.
